rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Data Compliance Classifier analyzes data before storage or transmission to determine sensitivity levels and applicable regulatory frameworks. It uses AI to classify data against GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and CCPA requirements and provides actionable guidance on safe handling. Teams can automate compliance checks in data pipelines without manual review.
